verdict.line: You lose if you let Riven farm to 6 untouched and eat a free Wind Slash trade; you win if you force all-ins between levels 3 and 5 while your Fury is full.

brief.thesis: Renekton's Fury bar creates hard, repeatable all-in windows — above 50 Fury his W (Ruthless Predator) becomes a 3-hit, 1.5s stun that shreds shields and his Q (Cull the Meek) heals harder — and those windows exist well before Riven's level 6 Wind Slash burst comes online. The 703-game sample backs this: Renekton wins this lane 54.2% of the time specifically because he can dictate when fights happen, not because he out-damages her in a fair fight.

tell.watch: Your Fury bar and her E cooldown

theirWindow.what: Riven will use Valor to step in and block your incoming damage before chaining Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) for the stun. Don't throw your full combo into a fresh Valor — bait it with autos or a single Q first, then commit once it's down (10/9/8/7/6s cooldown by rank).

yourWindow.what: Auto-attack the wave or trade briefly until Fury crosses 50, then all-in: empowered W lands a 1.5s stun and destroys any shield she's holding, and empowered Q hits harder and heals you more. This is the trade the matchup data is built on — take it every time it's up.

start.why: Runs 53.6% over 716 games at 82.9% pick — the sustain and early AD let you win the level 1-2 trades her Ki Burst can't yet punish.

boots.why: 53.5% over 707 games at 84.6% pick; the flat physical damage reduction blunts her auto-reset combo and the free hits she gets during Broken Wings dashes.

core.why: First item in the 60.4%-winrate path (139 games); the proc rewards exactly the burst all-ins your Fury windows are built around.
Second in both top paths (60.4% and 67.8% samples); armor shred keeps your empowered W and Q hitting hard as she buys tank items.
60.4% over 139 games as the third item; lets you commit to extended all-ins without her poke chip-killing you afterward.

situational.when: you're ahead and want to survive her Blade of the Exile all-ins instead of racing burst
you want the cooldown refund to chain W stuns more often (40.7% over 54 games as a third-item alternative)
her team stacks extra CC beyond her own kit (60.9% over 115 games when taken)
you need to stick to her through Valor dashes in extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest recorded win rate for this build (60.1%, 17.3% pick); the burst-plus-vulnerability proc pairs with your empowered W stun to end short trades before she can land her own combo.

summoners.why: Dominant pick at 89.4% with a 55.3% win rate — Ignite closes out your Fury all-in windows for kills instead of just chip damage, especially in the 3-5 level range where you have the trade advantage.

playing.title: Farm to full Fury before engaging
playing.detail: Your passive builds Fury off attacks — hit the wave or auto her when safe until the bar crosses 50, then commit your combo. A half-Fury W is a much worse trade.

playing.title: Bait Valor before all-in
playing.detail: Poke with a single Q or an auto first to draw out her E (Valor, 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown). Once it's down she has no block left for your empowered combo.

playing.title: End the lane before 6
playing.detail: Riven has no Wind Slash until Blade of the Exile comes online. Stack your all-in windows between levels 3 and 5 while she can't punish you from range.

playing.title: Track her Broken Wings charges
playing.detail: Q can be reactivated up to three times in a short window, with the third hit knocking back — if she's burned all three charges chasing or repositioning, she's temporarily out of escape.

playing.title: Chain W as it ranks up
playing.detail: Ruthless Predator drops from 16s to 8s cooldown by rank 5 — once it's near max rank you can threaten a stun almost every other trade.

playing.title: Play level 6 safer
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile grants bonus AD, range, and a one-time Wind Slash. Don't extend trades she can finish from range that level — reset and wait for your next Fury window instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (703-game sample for this matchup); the Fury-window timing and trade sequencing is my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out for Riven’s Conqueror stacks before engaging her. Use your abilities off cooldown whenever Fury is full to easily gain lane control.
